name: Matsuoka Yuuki
source: Yuuki is Tsukushi's best friend as well as a childhood friend. The two work together at a dango shop after school. Tsukushi and Yuuki also went to kindergarten, elementary school and junior high together. She cares a lot about Tsukushi's feelings and does not want anybody to hurt Tsukushi.
translation: Yuuki is Tsukushi's best friend as well as a childhood friend. The two work together at a dango shop after school.
